title.rendered: Arqaam Capital Wins “Sukuk Fund of the Year” at the Global Banking & Markets Awards

content.rendered:
We are thrilled to announce that Arqaam Capital’s Fixed Income Asset Management team has been awarded “Sukuk Fund of the Year” at this year’s Global Banking & Markets Awards.

Awards recognising long-term performance are a true reflection of our process and discipline. Since the inception of our Fixed Income Asset Management business, the team has earned multiple performance accolades, and we are proud to add this latest honour — our third Global Banking & Markets award in four years — to that track record.

What drives this recognition is simple: a dedicated team relentlessly committed to delivering the best outcomes for our investors.

A huge congratulations to the team behind this achievement:

🌟 Abdul Kadir Hussain, CFA
🌟 Mehdi POPOTTE, CFA
🌟 Fady Gendy, CFA
🌟 Nadim Amatouri, CFA
🌟 Jad Rayess
🌟 Abdullah Albilal, MSc
🌟 Cyril S.
🌟 Biju Das

This win reiterates our commitment to excellence in the Sukuk space. Thank you to our team — and above all, to our investors for their continued trust and partnership.

View More
